description: This Java class 'AutowiredRegistrationAdapter' extends 'EventBusRegistrationAdapter' and acts as a Spring component that injects a 'RegistrationService' instance, specifically qualified as 'backend', and provides it via an overridden 'getService' method. It functions as an adapter to connect the registration service with an event bus mechanism within the Hono device registry project.

classes.name: AutowiredRegistrationAdapter
classes.description: A final Spring component class that extends EventBusRegistrationAdapter, acting as an adapter to inject a RegistrationService instance.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Setter method with @Autowired and @Qualifier annotations to inject the 'RegistrationService' bean labeled 'backend'.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Overrides the parent class method to return the injected RegistrationService instance.
